blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
"SELECT id, org_id, number, total_cents, issued_on FROM invoices WHERE id = $1",
[id],
findings.recommendation: Scope the lookup to the caller's organization (`WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2` with `currentUser(req).orgId`), answer 404 when it does not match, and add a test that a caller from another organization gets 404 (CWE-639 / CWE-862).
findings.title: GET /invoices/:id returns any organization's invoice

findings.recommendation: Log the error server-side only and answer a generic body such as `{ error: "internal error" }`; never serialize `err.stack` or raw `err.message` into the response (CWE-209).
findings.title: Error handler sends the exception message and stack trace to the client
